list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM runs UNION SELECT environment FROM schedule_settings ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Leave Request Agent
panels.description: Latest healthcheck for this agent in the selected environment. Healthy: a non-empty answer and complete stream within the slow threshold. Slow: complete response above the threshold (10 seconds by default). Error: request error, empty answer, or incomplete stream. Total is the full request duration; TTFT is time to the first answer token.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(r.status, 'Unknown') AS "Status", CASE WHEN r.finished_at IS NULL THEN 'No healthcheck yet' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 minute' THEN 'Checked: just now' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 hour' THEN 'Checked: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 60)::int || ' min ago' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'Checked: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 3600)::int || ' h ago' ELSE 'Checked: ' || to_char(r.finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') END AS "Checked", 'Total: ' || COALESCE(round((r.duration_ms / 1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || ' s', '—') || ' (TTFT: ' || COALESCE(round((r.ttft_ms / 1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || ' s', '—') || ')' AS "Total", 'Stream: ' || CASE WHEN r.stream_complete IS TRUE THEN 'complete' WHEN r.stream_complete IS FALSE THEN 'incomplete' ELSE 'unknown' END AS "Stream",r.run_id AS "Run ID",r.dify_log_url AS "Dify log" FROM (VALUES (1)) seed(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status,finished_at,ttft_ms,duration_ms,stream_complete,run_id,dify_log_url FROM runs WHERE kind='healthcheck' AND agent='leave' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true

panels.title: Leave Request Agent
panels.description: Latest evaluation for this agent in the selected environment. Pass: all completed metrics pass and no critical business rule fails. Fail: at least one completed metric or critical rule fails. Error: a metric could not be evaluated. Score is the arithmetic mean of completed metric scores; skipped metrics are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(r.verdict,'No data') AS "Status",CASE WHEN r.finished_at IS NULL THEN 'No evaluation yet' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 minute' THEN 'Evaluated: just now' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '1 hour' THEN 'Evaluated: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 60)::int || ' min ago' WHEN r.finished_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'Evaluated: ' || floor(extract(epoch FROM (now() - r.finished_at)) / 3600)::int || ' h ago' ELSE 'Evaluated: ' || to_char(r.finished_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') END AS "Checked",'Case: ' || COALESCE(left(r.case_id,24) || CASE WHEN length(r.case_id)>24 THEN '…' ELSE '' END,'—') AS "Case",'Score: ' || COALESCE(round(r.score::numeric,3)::text,'—') AS "Score",'Total: ' || COALESCE(round((r.duration_ms/1000.0)::numeric,3)::text || ' s','—') AS "Total",r.run_id AS "Run ID",r.dify_log_url AS "Dify log" FROM (VALUES (1)) seed(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT verdict,finished_at,case_id,score,duration_ms,run_id,dify_log_url FROM runs WHERE kind='evaluation' AND agent='leave' AND environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY started_at DESC,run_id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true
